title: Man Thinks He Can Attack Cops Without Consequence
description:
An officer became subject to verbal harassment by three individuals when he arrived on the scene to investigate their complaint of a robbery. The complainants wanted him to chase after the suspects and got visibly aggressive as the officer performed his due diligence. Clayton sliced his own hand multiple times with the knife that he threatened the officer with and then escaped into one of the properties. More officers arrive on the scene to apprehend Clayton. Clayton was stopped from entering a residence at gunpoint but then he fled further into the woods. He might've had a chance to escape but his bleeding hands were leaving behind a strong trail for the K9 to sniff. Clayton was tracked by the newest K9 hire of the department. Despite having blood all over him, he refused medical attention several times claiming that he had just tattooed himself. Clayton was charged with Aggravated Assault on a Law Enforcement Officer and Resist Officer Without Violence.

The raw footage for the videos on this channel have been obtained directly from the respective Police Departments. We as a media company have the right to use it commercially. Most incidents may require a fee associated with the request and take several days to process.

The channel is not affiliated with any law enforcement agency.

Our channel is compliant with YouTube's Fair Use Policy as we create a storyline and cut down several hours of long footage to a few minutes to bring out the most entertaining and educational parts, just like other channels such as Code Blue Cam, Real World Police, Active Police Cam, Blue Watch and Bodycam FIles.

The featured content is NOT intended to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved or to glorify violence in any way.
